title: Fix issue `Unread message count in Tab overflow menu`
body: Fixes #906

comments_data.body:
Thanks for this @lebaphi  :-)

Could you explain why you had to use CSS styling for the numbers, instead of the `onRenderTab()` method?

It's a clever strategy, but I'm just double-checking the complexity is justified.

> Thanks for this @lebaphi :-)
> 
> Could you explain why you had to use CSS styling for the numbers, instead of the `onRenderTab()` method?
> 
> It's a clever strategy, but I'm just double-checking the complexity is justified.

hi @IanMayo , I just follow the same way as the function `setUnreadClassName` (in `onRendereTab()`) did. We have the CSS class name `unread-<number-unread-message>`, and we update the node unread message count by calling: `node.getModel().doAction(...)`. In this issue, it's just the menu item, (not a node element), so I get each item and add the class to style to unread message count. I can do this by javascript but I think using the CSS styling is better.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26705621/125547467-c10bb700-9f56-4333-9473-46474d703052.png)
Fixed @IanMayo, the unread message count work stable now 👍

issues.title: Unread message count in Tab overflow menu
issues.body:
Some users need to track new messages across lots of channels.

If there are too many channels to view at once, the other fall into an overflow menu:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/124175174-32b34300-daa5-11eb-9246-41212539cf13.png)

This menu doesn't include an indication of if there are unread messages in that channel.

It would be great if the channel name could be followed by ` (4)` - to indicate 4 unread messages.

_Maybe_ if the overflow tabs used a _formatting function_ instead of just the tab name. We could look up the unread message count, and provide that in the formatting function.

Aah, this looks like what we're looking for:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1108513/124175485-95a4da00-daa5-11eb-874f-a0eb143d5945.png)

(above game [here](https://serge-review.herokuapp.com/?wargame=wargame-kqgy546g&access=pkoiqu5ev) )
